text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit that what you can't do, you can't 
do!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can train my weaknesses with 
all my might! To aim for the top with 
everything I've got! To the absolute 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go pushing yourself so hard when 
you're so damn weak...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everyone starts out weak. But there's 
really nothing to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
“Admit to yourself first that you're 
weak!”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"And so I made up my mind. Even if it 
means exposing my unpolished self before 
my beloved Funabashi... —I will become 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise, you won't even be able to get 
stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ――……Shut…… up…… ……Shut……――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
…………Espo-san? Um, are you okay? Your face 
is――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Doctor, please come quick! 
Espo-san! Espo-san isâ!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
I have her resting in bed right now. I 
believe it's likely just a temporary 
stomachache, but...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
If the pain persists, please consider 
having her see a doctor. ...Umamusume are 
delicate, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving word through her homeroom 
teacher that "Espoir City collapsed," I 
rushed to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the school nurse's diagnosis, 
it might be a stress-induced stomach ache. 
For now, we'll keep an eye on it...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Espo!? You should rest a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I want to go home...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I wanna go hoooome............!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I get permission from Espoir City's 
homeroom teacher and complete the 
paperwork for her "early dismissal."
choice_data_list: (...Sorry, Espo.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without hesitating. Without using staying 
by their side as an excuse for 
procrastination. ...If only I hadn't 
waited around.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list:
...Espo, take a seat. I'll wake you up 
when we arrive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should have made the decision right 
away. Her hesitation, her anxiety, her 
destination—all of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only the adults had removed everything 
without question or hesitation. She never 
would have had to suffer like this—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We meet up with her mother, whom we had 
contacted. Now that we've made it this 
far, she should be able to relax.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, I wanted her to get some good 
rest. In a place free from races, free 
from anxiety—"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Come here, Espo, you're safe now. Mommy's 
right here with you..."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Espo...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No! Not here...! Not... this way...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Where I'm... Where I'm heading is...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...It's so I can talk back to that damn 
old man of mine...!!"
choice_data_list: —Espo?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(All this agony, all this pain. All of it. 
—Every single bit of it............!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Pisses me off...! It pisses me off so 
much!! Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ha—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...It's still the middle of the day.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shut up...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: —Espo!!
choice_data_list: Espo—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to quickly renting a car, I somehow 
managed to catch up to Espoir City. And 
she—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I came here to give YOU a piece of my 
mind!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You... YOU were the one...! You're the one 
who told me that back then, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak! 
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any 
stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Espo—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't stop me!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you damn old man! You told me 
yourself, didn't you!? To "admit my 
weakness"!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise you won't get stronger!" Just 
'cause I'm weak...!! But—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Still!! You're telling me I can't get 
stronger without admitting my own 
weakness!?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: Dunno.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...How the hell should I know? It's not 
like I can see the future."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Still, guess it just wasn't your cup of 
tea, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Because I wasn't able to raise you to the 
level you're at now.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: What I knew was just general theory.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever, I've still got work left. You 
get back to the academy too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ――……Gh, damn it……!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't screw with me!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Stop messing around! That's...! You mean 
you quit this whole time...!? Ever since 
you started teaching me... this whole damn 
time.........!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And yet...! All this time, I was...! I 
was...!!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm your father, but... I could never 
be your Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer. Please take care of Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't run away!! You damn old man!! Damn 
it... shit............!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
To something like this... this kind of 
thing.........! All this time......... the 
entire time......!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What a bunch of crap…………!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm heading back to Tracen Academy." 
After parting with her father, Espoir City 
murmured those words quietly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—'Acknowledge your weakness to become 
stronger.' I thought that was a universal, 
unwavering truth. And so did she."
choice_data_list: (Still, it didn't suit her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For someone who wished to be strong for 
her mother's sake and despised weakness, 
what was the true way to become strong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's the exact opposite.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...? What's up?
choice_data_list:
...Hey, how about we just break away like 
this?

……Hey, how about we just shake them off 
like this?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Shake them off?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Espoir City I've seen is stubborn and 
eager to look strong, requiring a tailored 
approach even during training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she's such a ball of rebellion, 
she can find an answer that's uniquely her 
own.
choice_data_list: You are you, Espo.
You are who you are, Espoir.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...So in the end, did you figure out if 
even the 'Legendary Umamusume' has shown 
any weakness~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So, what are we gonna do? You just have no 
clue what to do next, don't you?
choice_data_list:
That's why you're the one who gets to 
choose, Espo.
That's why it's up to you to choose, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Choose, you mean...
choice_data_list:
You're the one who makes the path you 
chose the right one.

You're the one who makes the path you 
chose the right one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether accepting your weakness to grow, 
or rejecting your weakness to move 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you try to accept your weakness 
and can't quite do it. Even if rejecting 
it is the only way you can move forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—No matter which path you take, as long 
as you become stronger along the way, 
that's the right choice.”
choice_data_list:
You have the power to make your own 
choices the right ones.
You can make yourself the right answer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Making the chosen path the right one... 
that's on me...
choice_data_list: You have that kind of strength within you.
You have that kind of strength within you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She could confront everything she disliked 
head-on. I had always watched her, 
admiring that unique strength of hers.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You're sure about this, right? ...I get to 
decide how we do things.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it in the February Stakes 
too! I'm gonna do things my way, just like 
I decided!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll give it to you――my very own answer!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (I am strong.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I am strong! I'm strong! Strong! 
Strong!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: She's an insanely... powerful horse girl!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the day of the February Stakes 
arrived.
